notes: Kett: insectoid hive-workers. Amber chitin, a split domed shell on the back with a welded scrap patch, FOUR thin arms (the upper two hold items at the shared hand targets; the lower two are small and stay tucked against the chest in every pose), antennae and two glossy dark compound eyes, thin legs with a long stride. Head variants: antennae, torn (one antenna snapped), helmet (a work hardhat, tinted, antennae through slots). Outfit mask = tool belt, shoulder straps, bracers, shin wraps, hardhat. Same rig as human: every layer faces UP at rotation 0 on one 33x33 frame, rotate about the pivot; outfit pixels are neutral grey in the base PNG and white in *_color.png (multiply by the outfit colour there); no baked shadow.

legs.notes: frames 0 and 3 are the contacts; the swing boot (frames 1-2 right, 4-5 left) is lifted

arms.notes: item placement: item top-left = mount - item.grip (both unrotated), then rotate the upper group about the pivot. Mounts are identical on every species (and the human), so any item fits any body. Pose = the item's class: pistol, rifle, tool, heavy, melee.
